selection: Private CPU7; two sorted randperm indices per fixed subject0..5, in subject order; no scores consulted
private_panels: One private CPU43 torch.randn([2,12,16,16]); role0=D,role1=G; same raw panels across all four learned judges/ingredients; sigma.125; antithetic uses negative existing draw and no additional RNG
host: Unchanged fresh public-initialized two-site rank2/width16/tokens16/128x4 particle host, zero-Up sampled H/b/C; trainable bank/router and public native RoutedRows. FAST only.
known_solution: r(theta)=one actual clean FAST routed output(theta)-the same output detached at fresh zero-Up, then divide by the saved critic scale. Exact r=0; this constructed target is not the rotated-task teacher target.
reflection: Subclass held ConditionalCritic without new learned tensors or parameter names. Features=.5*(F(e,c)+F(-e,c)); held pooled linear score makes D_even reflection-even too. Same learned weights and condition.
objectives: Public particlegan.GANLoss RpGAN, context scalar AFTER16-token feature pooling; single sign or mean two existing noise signs. Per-context G forces and separate B4 means; D-role scalar values only. No output MSE objective/guards.
count: Exactly3 actual full tiny-generator forwards, reused across4 judges×4 controls;192 per-context gradients and48 B4-mean gradients. No native policy/optimizer/diagnostic calls, no gradient-buffer writes.
immutability: Before/after native full policy checkpoint including optimizer/config/RNG/diagnostics, all owner tensors,modes,requires_grad flags,.grad,hook identities; critic and data states; private/global RNG; original input and source file SHAs. Post-write/report-SHA/completion-write120-second checks; complete evidence requires bound completion.json.
limits: An arbitrary stale frozen critic can push an exact generator; this is not a violation of true joint GAN equilibrium because the critic need not be at its own optimum.
Reflection-even features/scores plus antithetic signs enforce local frozen-critic stationarity, not convergence rate, stability, structural correctness or optimizer-default promotion.
Evenization removes first-order signed conditional mean discrimination and can slow acquisition. Whether it helps acquisition remains untested.

The constructed known solution is the fresh FAST output, not the held rotated teacher target. Zero-Up necessarily zeros code/H/b/C/down/bank/router gradients; this is not evidence of their inactivity after acquisition.
Only twelve fixed balanced fit contexts and four small CPU learned critics are inspected. This does not explain the late full-Supra or ordinary-versus-particle convergence gap.

The residual-coordinate negative-gradient slope is exact continuous game algebra. The Up slope is native autograd linearization through BF16 casts, not a literal infinitesimal derivative of a quantized parameter function; no step is taken.
No optimizer or model updates, newly trained critics, output objective, seed/quality/epsilon/head scan, full Supra checkpoint/forward or GPU work. Software verification cost is separately reported.
